title: fuzz/property tests where useful
description: Add proptest-based fuzz coverage for geometry2d primitives. Create engine-rs/tests/fuzz_geometry2d_property_test.rs covering Rect2 (intersects/encloses/grow/abs/has_point), Vector2 (length/normalized/rotated/lerp/dot/cross), and Transform2D (compose/affine_inverse/xform/xform_inv) operations. Use proptest with at least 5 property tests per type. Properties should assert algebraic invariants (e.g. v.normalized().length() ≈ 1.0 for non-zero, t.affine_inverse() * t ≈ identity, rect.encloses(rect.grow(n)) for n>=0). Test must compile and pass via: scripts/rust_task.sh nextest run -p patina-engine --test fuzz_geometry2d_property_test
acceptance_criteria: engine-rs/tests/fuzz_geometry2d_property_test.rs exists; uses proptest crate; covers Rect2, Vector2, Transform2D; at least 15 property tests total; passes nextest run with default 256 cases per property

title: Implement collision layer/mask filtering for all 3D body types
description:
IMPLEMENT collision layer and mask bitfield filtering for RigidBody3D, StaticBody3D, CharacterBody3D, and Area3D.

Godot uses 32-bit layer/mask bitfields so bodies only interact when (A.layer & B.mask) != 0. This filtering must be checked in broadphase before generating contact pairs.

Files to modify:
- engine-rs/crates/gdphysics3d/src/collision.rs (broadphase layer check)
- engine-rs/crates/gdphysics3d/src/body.rs (layer/mask properties)
- engine-rs/crates/gdphysics3d/src/area3d.rs (layer/mask for area overlap)

Acceptance: ./scripts/rust_task.sh nextest run --test physics3d_trace_comparison_test -- collision_layer

[planner-key: physics-layers]
